xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2698: Codex role spawns get no MCP servers — test role cannot run required browser UAT on codex (Playwright missing)

plan.title: Codex role spawns get no MCP servers — test role cannot run required browser UAT on codex (Playwright missing)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: roles/test.md declares Playwright as a role MCP server in frontmatter (roles/test.md:14-20). The claude-code launcher provisions it via roleSystemPromptInjectionSync (src/lib/agents/runtime-command.ts:613-633 → --mcp-config), but the codex launcher never translates role MCP config into the per-agent codex-home/config.toml: initCodexHome (src/lib/runtimes/codex.ts:178-254) writes no [mcp_servers] section. Any UAT-required issue therefore auto-fails testing whenever the test role routes to codex — role MCP declarations are silently dropped for every codex-harness role spawn (observed on the PAN-2683 test run, 2026-07-15).
narratives.Proposal: Extract the role-frontmatter mcpServers parser into a shared helper; have initCodexHome accept an mcpServers option and emit [mcp_servers.<name>] TOML sections (codex-cli 0.144.4 supports this natively); thread the role through getCodexLauncherFields at all 5 role-spawn call sites (fresh spawn, spawn-prep, resume, recovery, planning) so the always-rewritten config.toml keeps MCP on relaunch; warn when a role declaring MCP servers spawns on ohmypi, which cannot provision them; document per-harness provisioning.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No MCP provisioning for ohmypi/pi harness (warning only)
- No hard routing gate refusing to spawn MCP-declaring roles on non-provisioning harnesses
- No revert of the operator's roles.test.model pin in ~/.overdeck/config.yaml (operator-owned config; fix makes it unnecessary)
- No sweep for the stale .pan/records-expectation secondary observation (issue defers it unless it recurs)
- No MCP provisioning for codex conversation sessions (conversation-runtime.ts) — conversations have no role
- No change to codex sandbox/approval policy for browser launches

autoDecisions.summary: Chose the issue's primary fix direction (provision role MCP servers into codex-home/config.toml) over the alternative harness-routing gate.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names config.toml provisioning first and frames routing awareness as 'alternatively (or additionally)'; provisioning restores full harness freedom for the test role, while a routing gate would keep codex second-class.

autoDecisions.summary: Non-provisioning harnesses (ohmypi) get a spawn-time console warning, not a hard refusal.
autoDecisions.rationale: A hard gate could block pipeline spawns on a soft dependency; the incident's harm was silence, which a named warning fixes cheaply.

autoDecisions.summary: Sub-role spawns resolve MCP servers from the parent role file (roleAgentDefinitionPath single-arg overload).
autoDecisions.rationale: Sub-roles are prompt templates, not standalone roles; roles/review.md declares no MCP servers today so behavior is unchanged, and inheriting the parent is the only consistent rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Only stdio-shaped MCP entries (string command) are emitted into codex config.toml; anything else is skipped with a warning.
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex fails config load entirely on malformed config (initCodexHome's [model]-as-table note), which would brick every codex spawn — skip-and-warn is the only safe degradation.

items.title: Extract shared parseRoleMcpServersSync helper from roleSystemPromptInjectionSync

expected_outputs: role-mcp-parser.test.ts passes, asserting the flattened playwright entry parsed from roles/test.md frontmatter

narrative.Action: In src/lib/agents/runtime-command.ts, extract the mcpServers frontmatter flattening currently inlined in roleSystemPromptInjectionSync (lines 613-633: YAML list of single-key maps → one name→def record) into an exported helper `parseRoleMcpServersSync(definitionPath: string): Record<string, RoleMcpServerDef>` with `export interface RoleMcpServerDef { type?: string; command?: string; args?: string[]; env?: Record<string, string> }` (a permissive passthrough of the frontmatter object; unknown keys may be ignored). The helper reads the file, parses frontmatter with the existing parseYaml pattern, returns {} on missing file, missing frontmatter, malformed YAML, or absent mcpServers. Refactor roleSystemPromptInjectionSync to call the helper so the claude-code --mcp-config artifact and --allowedTools mcp__<name> suffixes are produced from the same parsed record — identical output to today. Add src/lib/agents/__tests__/role-mcp-parser.test.ts using a temp-dir role file mirroring roles/test.md frontmatter.
narrative.Rationale: Both harness paths must read one parser or they will drift; this also gives the ohmypi warning item a cheap way to ask 'does this role declare MCP servers?'.

items.title: Given a role file with roles/test.md's frontmatter, parseRoleMcpServersSync returns { playwright: { type: 'stdio', command: 'npx', args: ['-y', '@playwright/mcp@latest'] } }
Given a role file without mcpServers frontmatter or a nonexistent path, the helper returns an empty record and throws nothing

After the refactor, roleSystemPromptInjectionSync for a test-role definition still produces a --mcp-config flag pointing at a .mcp.json containing mcpServers.playwright and an --allowedTools value containing mcp__playwright
initCodexHome emits [mcp_servers.<name>] sections from a new InitCodexHomeOpts.mcpServers option

expected_outputs: codex.test.ts passes including new cases asserting the exact [mcp_servers.playwright] TOML lines, the skip-with-warn path, and the no-option byte-compat path

narrative.Action: In src/lib/runtimes/codex.ts, add `mcpServers?: Record<string, RoleMcpServerDef>` (import the type from src/lib/agents/runtime-command.ts — if that import would create a cycle, define the structural type locally in codex.ts and have runtime-command.ts satisfy it) to InitCodexHomeOpts. In initCodexHome's config.toml assembly, after the [projects."<dir>"] trust block, for each entry whose def has a non-empty string `command`: emit a blank line, `[mcp_servers.<name>]`, `command = "<command>"`, then `args = ["a", "b"]` when def.args is a non-empty array of strings, then `env = { "K" = "v", ... }` when def.env has entries. Escape every emitted string value and key with the same TOML basic-string escaping used for trustedDir (codex.ts:218 — backslash then double-quote). Server names must be emitted as quoted keys if they contain characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] (use `[mcp_servers."<escaped>"]`). Entries without a string command (e.g. url-based servers) are skipped with console.warn('[codex] skipping MCP server "<name>" — only stdio command servers are provisioned into codex config'). When opts.mcpServers is absent or empty, the emitted config.toml must be byte-identical to today's output. Restate: codex refuses to boot on malformed config.toml, so a bad emission bricks every codex spawn — the unit tests must assert exact emitted lines, including an escaping case (an arg containing a double-quote and a backslash).
narrative.Rationale: This is the missing half of the claude-code parity: codex-cli 0.144.4 natively loads [mcp_servers.<name>] with command/args/env for stdio servers.

items.title: Given mcpServers with the playwright stdio entry, initCodexHome produces a config.toml containing [mcp_servers.playwright] with command = "npx" and args = ["-y", "@playwright/mcp@latest"]
Given an entry without a string command, initCodexHome omits it from config.toml and logs a console.warn naming the skipped server
When opts.mcpServers is absent, initCodexHome produces config.toml output identical to the pre-change output (no [mcp_servers] text anywhere)
Given a command or arg value containing a double-quote or backslash, the emitted TOML escapes it (\" and \\) and the section remains parseable
Given def.env entries, initCodexHome emits env = { "KEY" = "value" } inside the server's section
Thread role through getCodexLauncherFields into initCodexHome at all five role-spawn call sites

expected_outputs: tests pass, including a case where a second initCodexHome rewrite with the same mcpServers preserves the [mcp_servers.playwright] section

narrative.Action: Add an optional trailing `role?: Role` parameter to getCodexLauncherFields (src/lib/agents/runtime-command.ts:177). When role is provided, resolve the top-level role definition via roleAgentDefinitionPath(role) (single-arg overload — sub-roles inherit the parent role file), call parseRoleMcpServersSync on it, and pass the result as initCodexHome's mcpServers option. Update every role-spawn call site to pass the role it already has in scope: src/lib/agents/spawn.ts:255 (`role`), src/lib/agents/spawn-prep.ts:481 (`launchRole`), src/lib/agents/messaging.ts:244 (`resumeRole`), src/lib/agents/recovery.ts:350 (`recoveryRole`), src/lib/planning/spawn-planning-session.ts:664 (the planning role, 'plan'). Leave the direct initCodexHome call in src/lib/overdeck/conversation-runtime.ts:575 unchanged — conversations have no role. Restate the hazard this item exists for: initCodexHome always rewrites config.toml, so a resume or recovery relaunch that omits the role would silently wipe the MCP section the fresh spawn wrote; that is why all five sites must pass it, not just spawn.ts.
narrative.Rationale: Completes FR-1 end-to-end for fresh spawns and FR-2 for resume/recovery, restoring test-role browser UAT on codex.

items.title: Given role 'test', getCodexLauncherFields produces a codex-home config.toml containing [mcp_servers.playwright]
When getCodexLauncherFields runs a second time for the same agent (resume/recovery rewrite) with role 'test', the rewritten config.toml preserves the [mcp_servers.playwright] section
Given a role whose definition declares no mcpServers (e.g. 'work'), the emitted config.toml contains no [mcp_servers] text and the spawn path throws nothing

All five call sites (spawn.ts, spawn-prep.ts, messaging.ts, recovery.ts, spawn-planning-session.ts) pass their in-scope role to getCodexLauncherFields — grep for 'getCodexLauncherFields(' shows a role argument at every non-test call site
Warn at spawn when a role declaring MCP servers routes to a harness that cannot provision them

expected_outputs: test asserting the ohmypi warning text (role, harness, server names) passes

narrative.Action: In getRoleRuntimeBaseCommand (src/lib/agents/runtime-command.ts:650-666), in the `launchCommandKind === 'ohmypi-rpc'` branch before returning: resolve roleAgentDefinitionPath(role), call parseRoleMcpServersSync, and if the record is non-empty emit console.warn(`[spawn] role '${role}' declares MCP servers (${names.join(', ')}) but harness 'ohmypi' does not provision MCP — those tools will be unavailable`). Do not warn on the codex or claude-code branches (both provision after this issue), and do not block or alter the returned command in any branch — this is observability only, per the recorded auto-decision against a hard routing gate.
narrative.Rationale: The incident's cost came from silence: the test agent ran a full green suite before discovering its required tools were missing. A named warning at spawn surfaces the mismatch immediately in agent logs.

items.title: Given role 'test' and harness 'ohmypi', getRoleRuntimeBaseCommand logs a warning containing the role name, 'ohmypi', and 'playwright'
Given harness 'ohmypi' with a role declaring no mcpServers, or role 'test' on claude-code/codex, getRoleRuntimeBaseCommand logs no such warning and returns the same command as before
Document per-harness role MCP provisioning

expected_outputs: grep shows the new provisioning sections referencing [mcp_servers] in both files
metadata.acJustification: Docs item verified by content presence; two criteria cover both touched files.

narrative.Action: Add a 'Role MCP servers' section to docs/ROLES.md that covers: the frontmatter shape (mcpServers as a YAML list of single-key maps, citing roles/test.md), and per-harness provisioning — claude-code renders a generated --mcp-config JSON plus mcp__<name> --allowedTools entries (PAN-2090); codex writes [mcp_servers.<name>] into the per-agent codex-home/config.toml at spawn and on every resume/recovery rewrite (PAN-2698); ohmypi does not provision and logs a spawn-time warning. In configuration/harnesses.mdx, add a sentence to the codex harness section stating that role-declared MCP servers (for example Playwright for the test role) are provisioned into the per-agent Codex config so browser UAT runs on codex. Follow each file's existing tone and heading conventions.
narrative.Rationale: The provisioning asymmetry was undocumented, which is why the gap survived until an incident; the docs item is required by the PRD-authoring rule.

items.title: docs/ROLES.md contains a Role MCP servers section that covers the frontmatter shape and names all three harness behaviors (claude-code --mcp-config, codex [mcp_servers], ohmypi warn-and-drop)
configuration/harnesses.mdx contains a codex-section sentence stating role-declared MCP servers are provisioned into the per-agent Codex config
